verdict.rationale: Whether a voice-agent platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Retell AI's source is available under any license: the docs cover a hosted platform, SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, with no mention of source code or licensing. A community thread treats open-source projects as alternatives to Retell, which suggests Retell itself is not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
